protocol: DGX Spark release noise pilot v1
purpose: Diagnose whether short-prefill latency steps persist in optimized Rust release builds; no candidate verdict or final power estimate
hypothesis: Unoptimized Rust framing/conversion contributes to the observed short-prefill delay distribution; retain both cycled and blocked conditions to expose order sensitivity
prefix_policy: Unique fixed-width three-digit salt per condition position, repetition, shape and warm/measure; prompt token counts must match within each shape
diagnostics: One-second GPU clocks/temperature/power/utilization and host CPU/load samples; default boost clocks; InferenceKit doctor before each arm
analysis: Retain every request; compare within-arm CV and temporal clusters by condition/shape/phase; two server arms are diagnostic, not independent performance proof

final_claim_target.round_count: Register from pilot before fresh main/main and main/PR acquisition; never extend a final run after observing its verdict

budget.authorization: Existing user-authorized exclusive lab qualification; no preemption or paid rental

build_policy.scope: Source-built CUDA qualification; not shipped dynamic package
